title: Robotics DAO: Above the Arroyo
summary: An agent-managed DAO campus set at NASA JPL in Pasadena, where physical AI is proven in the wild. Agents monitor, synthesize, draft and track robotics governance while humans alone vote, enact and appoint across five walkable zones.

districts.real_anchor: JPL Building 186 (Theodore von Kármán Museum and

buildings.use: Charter display, contribution model, measurable outcomes wall

buildings.name: Steward Annex
buildings.use: Human-only voting chamber for final votes and charter amendments

props: glass case of rover wheel molds

buildings.name: Synthesis Lab
buildings.use: Evidence monitoring and research summarization for stewards

buildings.name: Evidence Archive
buildings.use: Stored summaries and monitored robotics developments

buildings.name: Proposal Forum Hall
buildings.use: Agent-drafted proposals debated and decided by people

court.name: The von Kármán Court
court.style: Sunken terraced plaza ringed by mission-revival arcades and chaparral beds
court.why_here: Named for JPL's founder; a shared ground between lab buildings where agent work is reviewed and humans convene to govern.

quests.title: From Evidence to Draft
steps: Collect three evidence summaries from the Monitor Console Floor
Cross the court to the Proposal Forum Drafting Alcove
Watch the Proposal & Grant Drafter shape a draft
Confirm the draft is queued for human decision only

quests.title: Route the Working Group
steps: Read the routed task kanban with the Task Router
Carry the task brief up the Milestone Spiral Stair
Log the milestone with the Progress Tracker
Report the outcome dial reading back at the Ops Standup Corner

quests.title: Charter Check
steps: Read the charter and the measurable-outcomes scoreboard
List which actions are reserved for humans
Verify no agent terminal offers governance.final_vote
Watch stewards cast the final vote in the Decision Booth

quests.title: Arroyo Observation
steps: Climb to the Observation Deck above Hahamongna
Sketch rover-track timeline parallels to DAO milestones
Descend to Charter Hall and pin the sketch beside the Outcome Metrics Wall

quests.title: Scout the Collaborators
steps: Ask the Research Synthesis Agent for open robotics-governance questions
Meet the Collaborator Scout at the pin map
Add three expert leads to the Collaborator Directory
Notify the Task Router to open a working-group pod
